findings.description: _capture_identity compares a supplied source object with ordinary Python equality, allowing bytes=353800.0 to equal the fixed integer count. Re-canonicalizing with that supplied source preserves the float; subsequent _verify dictionary equality does not reject it. This does not bypass exact Git blob verification.
findings.requested_fix: Use a strict integer field check or independently constructed canonical expected source with integer SOURCE_BYTES; retain a regression for canonical altered float count.

findings.description: inspect_synthetic_notebook computes _blob(raw) before the 512KiB admission cap, duplicating/hash-processing oversized bytes before rejection.
findings.requested_fix: Validate exact bytes type and length before computing identity hash.

findings.description: No-code notebooks produce code_ast_parse_started=False and code_ast_parse_completed=True because completion is unconditional after the cell loop.
findings.requested_fix: Leave both exposure flags false when no code AST parser ran; inventory completion can remain its separate engineering status.

next_action: Review repaired held source and author/independent test evidence separately before any actual acquisition.
positive_scope: Static final-name categories are explicitly syntax only, including dead/function code.
Opaque literals and notebook outputs are not printed or evaluated; whole JSON and AST machine exposure are explicit.
Known category absence does not attest absence of transformations; positional slots avoid X/column semantics.
Source identity, committed-source and external CI/package gates remain distinct.
